items.text: Qabr ka azab haq hai. Agar kisi cheez se bach ke bhaagte to qabr ke azab se bhaagte.
Marne ke baad bande se poocha jayega: tera rab kaun tha, tera deen kya tha, tera nabi kaun tha.
Qabr me do farishte aayenge, unke naam Munkar aur Nakir hain. Wo sakht honge.
Qabr imaan wale ke liye tang ki jayegi, phir uski neki use wasee kar degi.
Qabr jannat ke baghichon me se ek baghicha hai, ya jahannam ke gaddhon me se ek gaddha.
Maut ka farishta rooh nikalte waqt zalim ke saamne khada hota hai, uska jism sakht ho jata hai.
Rooh nikalte waqt nek bande ko khushkhabri di jati hai, zalim ko dhamki.
Qabr me sawal ke waqt imaan wala saabit qadam rahega, munafiq ladkhadayega.
Qabron ki ziyarat karo, ye aakhirat ki yaad dilati hai.
Maut ka zaiqa har jaan ne chakhna hai, phir hamari taraf laut kar aana hai.
Jise maut aayi usne apna sab kuch chhod diya, sirf amal saath gaya.
Aadmi jis haal me marta hai, usi haal me uthaya jayega.
Qabr ke andhera me roshni kisi ki kaam nahi aayegi, sirf amal ki.
Murdar ko teen cheezein chhod deti hain: maal, khandaan aur amal. Do laut jate hain, amal reh jata hai.
Kafan me jeb nahi hoti. Jo duniya me jama kiya, wo peeche reh jata hai.
Qabr me tanhai ka saathi sirf amal hai, chahe chhota ho ya bada.
Qabristan ki taraf se guzarte waqt agar tum jaante, to tum kam hanste.
Qabr se bada koi manzar nahi. Jo wahan se guzar gaya, wo sab kuch dekh chuka.
Maut ke waqt har shakhs duniya me wapas jaane ki khwahish karega, taaki neki kar sake.
Qayamat tak qabr me rehna hai. Ye intezaar ka ghar hai, aaram ka nahi.
Jo apni qabr ko roz yaad karta hai, duniya uske dil me chhoti hoti jati hai.
Maut achanak aati hai. Jo aaj kaam taal deta hai, kal ka mauqa use na mile.
Murdar ke paas amal ke siva koi chiz nahi pahunchti, dua aur sadqa-e-jariya bhi amal hi hain.
Jisne qabr ko tayyar nahi kiya, wo musafir nahi, raste me hi hai.
Qabr me nek amal farishton ki shakal me aayega aur kahega: main tere saath hoon.
Jhoota, khayanat karne wala aur zulm karne wala — inki qabr tang hogi.
Qabr ke azab se bacho. Kaash tum dekh paate ki qabr me kya hota hai.
Maut ke baad koi amal qabool nahi hota. Abhi jo karna hai, abhi karo.
Zameen aadmi ke jism ko kha jati hai, sirf reed ki haddi reh jati hai, usi se uthna hai.
Qabr me bichhona andhera hai, chaadar amal hai.
Jo duniya me uncha ghar banata hai, qabr me uska thikana chhota ho jata hai.
Maut ka farishta kisi ko chhodta nahi, chahe wo raja ho ya faqeer.
Qabr me sawal se pehle kabhi kisi ne taiyari nahi ki, phir bhi sab se poocha jayega.
Apne marhoomin ko yaad karo, unke liye dua karo — kal tum bhi unhi me shamil ho.
Maut ke waqt maal ka hisaab duniya me hi le lo, wahan sirf pachtana hai.
Qabr sabse sacha aaina hai. Wo dikhata hai ki duniya kitni thodi thi.
Jise qabr yaad dilati hai, wo duniya ke fareb se bach jata hai.
Maut ka pehla manzil qabr hai. Wahan se aage koi wapsi nahi.
Kandha dene wale bhi laut jayenge, qabr me tanha rehna hoga.
Qabr ke andar ka manzar dekhne ke baad duniya ki har khushi halki lagti hai.
Jahannam ki aag dunya ki aag se sattar guna zyada garm hai.
Jahannam ka azab aisa hai ki agar uska ek kan duniya pe khol diya jaye, sab jal jaye.
Jahannam me sabse halka azab wala wahi hoga jiske pairon me aag ke angaar rakhe jayenge.
Jahannam kehti hai: mera hissa aur badha do, yahan tak ki Allah apna qadam usme rakhega.
Jahannam ke saat darwaze hain, har darwaze ka apna hissa muqarrar hai.
Jahannam me ek darakht hai jiska naam Zaqqum hai. Uska phal kareela jaisa hai.
Jahannam me aadmi ka rona aisa hoga ki aansu gaalon pe daudenge, phir khatam ho jayenge, phir khoon roenge.
Jahannam me daalne wale farishte sakht hain, wo azab kam nahi karte.
Dozakh me log dhuye me doobe rahenge, ek doosre ko pehchanenge bhi nahi.
Jahannam ke andar ka andhera aisa hai ki ek arsa tak kuch nazar nahi aayega.
Jahannam ki hawa-e-garm se chehre jhalas jayenge, ruh thehar nahi payegi.
Jahannam me sone ke angaar hain jo gardan me daale jayenge.
Jahannam ka pet khali nahi hota, wo barhta rehta hai.
Jahannam me ek aisi aag hai jise jinn aur insaan dono khate hain, garmi dil tak pahunchti hai.
Jahannam me ek wadi hai jiska naam Hub hai. Usme riya karne wale qaari dalenge.
Jahannam me ek ghaati hai jahan janwar ki ghaflat karne wale bhi jaenge.
Jahannam me daalne wale aise hain jo azab kisi par na rukenge, chahe apna hi ho.
Jahannam ke azab me ek sadi aisi hai ki insaan apne hi jism ko bhool jayega.
Jahannam me ghutno ke bal ghisat kar chalna hoga, sar jhuka hua hoga.
Jahannam ke aadmi ke sar pe pighla hua seesa daala jayega, dimaag ubal jayega.
Dozakh me log aag me jhulas kar dobara jilaye jayenge, jism ka rang kaala ho jayega.
Jahannam me kapde aag ke honge, aag hi libaas hogi.
Dozakh ka khaana zaqqum hoga, jo pet me aag ki tarah ubalti hai.
Jahannam me pyaas aisi hogi ki koi paani nahi milega, sirf khaula hua peep.
Jahannam me log apne apne gunahon ke mutabiq azab me honge, koi halka koi sakht.
Jahannam se nijaat ke liye aaj dua karo, kyunki wahan dua ki ijabat nahi hogi.
Dozakh ke aadmi aansu ki tarah baha kar aag bujhane ki koshish karenge, na bujhegi.
Jahannam me akela rehna, cheekhna, aur sunne wala koi na hona — yahi azab hai.
Jahannam ke aadmi aag ke dher par honge, duniya ke maal unke kaam nahi aayenge.
Dozakh ke darwaze khule hain, aaj ka mauqa jannat ke darwaze bhi khule hain.
Jahannam me na maut aayegi na aaram, sirf dard rehta hai.
Jahannam me amal ka koi fayda nahi, sirf pachtana hai.
Dozakh me naamaz ka, zakat ka, sach ka poocha jayega — sab udhar hai.
Jahannam me logon ki cheekh suni jayegi, lafz samajh nahi aayenge, bas dard ki awaaz hogi.
Jahannam ki haalat aisi hai ki zubaan bhi jal jayegi, bolna mushkil hoga.
Dozakh me daalne se pehle teen baar poocha jayega: kaun tha tera rab, kya tha tera deen.
Jahannam me dakhil hote waqt har aadmi ko apna amal dikhaya jayega, ek chhota bhi nahi chhutega.
Jahannam ke aadmi ko duniya me wapas bulaya jayega, phir na kuch saath aayega na kuch kar sakega.
Dozakh ki aag uske apne maal se bhi bhadkegi, jisne zakat nahi di.
Jahannam me sabse pehle namaz ka hisaab hoga, agar namaz hi gayi to baaki kya bachega.
Jannat me wo hai jo kisi aankh ne dekha nahi, kaan ne suna nahi, dil me nahi guzra.
Jannat me ek darakht hai jiske saaye me sawaar sattar saal tak chalta rahega.
Jannat ki eent sone aur chandi ki hai, uski mitti zafran ki.
Jo jannat me dakhil hoga wo kabhi dukhi nahi hoga, na uski maut aayegi.
Allah farmata hai: maine apne nek bandon ke liye wo taiyar kar rakha hai jo kisi aankh ne dekha nahi.
Jannat ke aath darwaze hain, aur jahannam ke saat.
Jannat me dudh, shehad aur sharaab ki nehrein hain, kisi dukh ke saath nahi.
Jannat me na koi fuzool baat hogi na jhoot, sirf salam aur salamti.
Jannat me log hamesha jawan rahenge, kabhi budhe nahi honge.
Jannat walon ka khana halq me na rukega, na unhein peshab ki zaroorat hogi.
Jannat me sab ka dil saaf hoga, kisi me kinna nahi hoga.
Jannat me ek din aisa hoga jisme suraj ki garmi nahi, sirf noor hoga.
Jannat walon ke chehre roshan honge, unhein dekh kar khushi hogi.
Jannat ki khushbu itni door se aayegi ki musafir uska rasta pakad lega.
Jannat me mahal aur bagh honge, nehrein uske neeche bahengi.
Jannat me hamesha ki zindagi hai, kabhi khatam nahi hogi.
Jannat ke darwaze par salam kaha jayega, phir andar dakhil kiya jayega.
Jannat walon ko dekh kar yakeen hoga ki duniya ka har dukh chhota tha.
Jannat me sabse bada inaam Allah ka deedar hoga.
Jannat ka rasta namaz aur amal se guzarta hai, aaj hi uspe chal do.
Agar tum jaante jo main jaanta, kam hanste aur zyada rote.
Jise hisaab se poch-gachh hogi, wo halaak ho jayega.
Qayamat ke din suraj qareeb kar diya jayega, paseena kaan tak pahunchega.
Qayamat ke din koi apne bhai, maa-baap aur aulaad se bhaag jayega.
Qayamat ke din amal nama khulega, koi chhota-bada amal baaqi nahi rahega.
Jiski nekiyon ka wazan bhaari wo bach gaya, jiski halki wo barbaad.
Qayamat ke din zulm andhere honge, zaalim ka haq kisi se bhi chhoota hua nahi chhodega.
Jo yateem ka maal zulm se khata hai, wo pet me aag bharta hai.
Sood khane wale ko qayamat ke din pagal ki tarah uthaya jayega.
Qayamat ke din pahaad dhuye ki tarah ud jayenge, zameen tehrabandi ki tarah phail jayegi.
Qayamat ke din haamila ka pet gir jayega, maa apne bachche ko bhool jayegi.
Jo takabbur se chalta hai, use zameen ke andar utaar diya jayega, qayamat tak dhadakta rahega.
Qayamat ke din har shakhs ghabrahat me hoga, anbiya bhi meri jaan meri jaan kahenge.
Har shakhs se uska waqt poocha jayega ki kis kaam me kharch kiya.
Qayamat ke din maal ek taraf rakh diya jayega, sirf amal kaam aayega.
Jiski zubaan mehfooz nahi, uski namaz bhi uske kaam nahi aayegi.
Gheebat karne wale ke liye qayamat ke din hisaab sakht hoga.
Qayamat ke din nekiyon ke pahaad aayenge, par log unhein uda denge — ye wo honge jinhone Allah se dar ke akela bhi gunah kiya.
Qarz ka haq ada kiye baghair mar gaya, uska maal aag ban jayega.
Paanch cheezon se pehle paanch cheezon ko ganimat samjho: jawani, sehat, maal, fursat, zindagi.
Do neamtein hain jinme log dhoke me hain: sehat aur fursat.
Riya se padhi namaz qayamat ke din aag me daali jayegi.
Jisne kisi ko qatl kiya, uska qisas qayamat me liya jayega.
Qayamat ke din zameen aisi hogi ki ek doodh wali oont bhi jagah na payegi.
Duniya me musafir ki tarah raho, jaise koi raste ka musafir hota hai.
